basins.name: CARROT RIVER NEAR ARMLEY
basins.method: CaLDAS-NSRPS 2.5 km model land-surface analysis; nearest-neighbour WCS geographic extraction (41×26 output pixels, 0.044435° longitude × 0.033952° latitude). Pixel centers clipped to original June 2024 gross basin polygon, including holes; cos(latitude) area-weighted mean of 434/434 valid inside pixels. Coverage is valid weighted sampled area; boundary cells are approximated by centers. Zero is numeric zero; nodata/negative/nonfinite/≥1e20 pixels excluded. This is a model estimate, not a measured basin survey; no seasonal normal supplied. Optional snow depth independently averaged from CaLDAS-NSRPS_2.5km_SnowDepth at the same analysis time (434/434 valid output pixels); metres converted to centimetres.
